item.title: Student Recital - Hannah Gammill — Dec 10, 2026
item.description:
Strauss Performing Arts Center Thursday, December 10, 2026 · 7:30 PM On Thursday, December 10, at 7:30 p.m., Hannah Gammill will perform a senior voice recital in the Strauss Performing Arts Center Recital Hall on the University of Nebraska at Omaha campus. Hannah will perform works by Arditi, Schubert, Beach, Hahn, and Fauré, with collaborative pianist Adam Hu. The performance will be live-streamed on the UNO School of Music YouTube channel.
Hannah Gammill (voice) is a student of Dr. Jen Townsley. Hannah is a music education student involved in UNO’s Opera Theatre program, having sung the role of Pamina in the program’s Spring 2026 production of Mozart’s Die Zauberflöte. As a member of UNO’s Concert Choir, Hannah was featured as a soloist in Frank La Rocca’s Mass of the Americas under the direction of Dr. Richard Carrillo. Hannah is a recipient of the Donald L. Fjellin Scholarship and the Michael J. Ruetz Memorial Scholarship award. With support from Voice Area faculty (Professor Justin Payne and Dr. Jen Townsley) and Music Education faculty (Dr. Shelly Cooper), Hannah has collaborated with musicians and community members through UNO’s Sound Health, Music & Memory, and HeartBeats programs founded by Dr. Mary Perkinson. As a member of UNO’s collegiate chapter of NAfME (National Association for Music Education), Hannah has represented UNO at the NAfME Collegiate Hill Day advocacy event and the Nebraska Music Educators Association conference with Dr. Katrina Cox. Hannah participated in the Nebraska Choral Directors Association Collegiate Internship at the 2026 NCDA Conference and currently serves as President of UNO’s Collegiate ACDA (American Choral Directors Association) chapter. Hannah would like to thank instructors of UNO’s Musical Theatre Opera Workshop, Curtis Reynolds, Danielle Laurion, Jen Townsley, Mackenzie Zielke, and Julian Adair, for their artistic and professional guidance. Source: UNO School of Music
